descriptor:
  id: weekly-group-inventory
  name: Weekly group inventory
  description: Reviews groups and reports findings for admin review.
  version: 0.1.0
  minAppVersion: 0.1.0
  author:
    name: Community
    handle: community
  category: policies
  mode: read
skills:
  - id: load_groups
    format: graph
    label: Load groups
    detail: Reads groups from the active tenant.
    settings:
      method: GET
      path: /groups
      select:
        - id
        - displayName
        - groupTypes
        - membershipRule
      scopes:
        - Group.Read.All
  - id: count_by_grouptypes
    format: transform
    label: Count groups by groupTypes
    detail: Breaks groups down by groupTypes.
    settings:
      kind: count-by-field
      source: '{{ load_groups.output }}'
      field: groupTypes
      buckets:
        - Unified
        - DynamicMembership
  - id: summarize
    format: llm
    label: Summarize
    detail: Generates a short groups report.
    settings:
      system: >-
        You review groups for Microsoft 365 admins and report findings for them to review before anything happens. Be concise, factual, and conservative. Use only
        the supplied data.
      prompt: >-
        Total groups: {{ load_groups.output | size }}. Details: {{ count_by_grouptypes.output }}. Write a compact report: main finding, what to verify, next
        action.
      temperature: 0.2
      maxTokens: 400
definition:
  triggers:
    - id: manual
      kind: manual
    - id: schedule
      kind: scheduled
      intervalSeconds: 604800
  result:
    summary: '{{ summarize.output.text | default("Summary unavailable") }}'
    data:
      total: '{{ load_groups.output | size }}'
      breakdown: '{{ count_by_grouptypes.output }}'
